comments.text: Budget billing works by using the average of the previous year's bills to calculate a flat monthly rate for the current year. Some months you will use less energy, but you pay the same rate. Higher months like the summer/winter, you pay the same rate. If you cancel and have an accrued balance, you have to pay the accused balance in full before going to the regular bill. I use it because I don't like surprises. I am not factoring in the data centers, just how it this is suppose to work in principle.
